name: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
headline: AutoClip turns long videos into short clips locally
lede: You can feed one link to an open-source desktop tool and get short clips with subtitles, covers and post copy from a long podcast, interview or course.

effects.effect: Open alternatives to paid clipping services grow

possibilities.title: Video editors can add depth-based effects to auto-cut clips without manual masking

with.title: Apple Depth Pro 2 gives frame-consistent metric depth
ffmpeg-skill for coding agents stays on weekly trending

possibilities.connection: AutoClip turns long recordings into short clips, Depth Pro 2 gives metric depth that stays consistent across frames, and the ffmpeg-skill lets a coding agent apply local edits, so depth mattes can drive blur, relighting or parallax across a whole batch of clips.

appearances.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
appearances.summary: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
